title: Mars Base 7, Part 5: The Landing Site
sources: Characters, bases and events are fictional (SCIFI series)

lines.text: Mei changed our landing site. On purpose.
Previously: a dead base called us. And it knew Mei.
Mei finally opened the seed tin.
My father was Hiro. He ran Base Three.
When it went silent, they said he was lost. I never believed them.
Under the seeds, there was one old note.
Come close. I will be listening. And it had coordinates.
So Mei had quietly moved our landing site. Twelve kilometres from his.
You put the whole crew next to a ghost base, because of a note?
I'm sorry. I only needed to be close enough to hear him.
Mei. It's Lena Voss. Your father is alive.
And Base Three still has a working air plant.
Tomorrow, we drive to the canyon.
